entities.summary: Michael Edward Love is an American singer and lyricist who co-founded the Beach Boys alongside his cousins Brian, Dennis, and Carl Wilson and their friend Al Jardine. Characterized by his nasal and sometimes baritone singing, he has consistently contributed to their studio albums while usually serving as their front man on stage since 1961, in which he is the only original member of the band performing under the name.
